# Wave Mechanics

Louis de Broglie proposed that matter exhibits both wave-like and particle-like characteristics. The wavelength of a material particle depends inversely on its linear momentum $p$:

$$
\lambda = \frac{h}{p}
$$

This relation laid the empirical foundation for [[Physics/Quantum/Schrodinger|Erwin Schrödinger's formulation]] of wave equations.
